Name: line_spend_usd
Description: Total OpenInvoice line spend in USD (sum of line amounts including fees and surcharges). Filter by year supplier category or generic product.

Name: classified_spend_usd
Description: Line spend in USD that maps to an approved generic product in the supply chain taxonomy.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_INVOICE_LINE_CLASSIFIED.IS_CLASSIFIED = 1 THEN V_INVOICE_LINE_CLASSIFIED.LINE_AMOUNT_USD ELSE 0 END)

Name: classified_spend_share
Description: Share of line spend classified to a generic product (0-1). The complement is the classification backlog.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_INVOICE_LINE_CLASSIFIED.IS_CLASSIFIED = 1 THEN V_INVOICE_LINE_CLASSIFIED.LINE_AMOUNT_USD ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(V_INVOICE_LINE_CLASSIFIED.LINE_AMOUNT_USD), 0)

Name: unclassified_spend_usd
Description: Line spend in USD without an approved generic product (no classification row or status Needs review or Unclassified).

Name: unclassified_line_count
Description: Number of invoice lines in the steward queue (no approved generic product).

Name: std_quantity
Description: Quantity in the generic product's standard unit of measure (gallons tons feet days barrels hours) after pack conversion.

Name: std_unit_price_usd
Description: Volume-weighted standard unit price in USD per standard UOM: classified line spend divided by standard quantity. Compare across suppliers pack sizes basins or months.

Name: supplier_count
Description: Number of distinct suppliers (by SAP vendor number LIFNR) with invoice lines in scope.

Name: generic_product_count
Description: Number of distinct approved generic products with spend in scope.

Name: savings_at_best_price_usd
Description: USD that would have been saved had all volume of a generic product in a year been bought at the lowest supplier average standard unit price observed that year.

Name: price_dispersion_pct
Description: Highest supplier standard unit price divided by the lowest minus one in percent for a generic product and year.

Name: best_std_unit_price_usd
Description: Lowest supplier average standard unit price observed for a generic product in a year.

Name: pricebook_variance_usd
Description: Sum of (invoiced unit price minus contract rate) times quantity over lines matched to a loaded price book; positive means invoiced above contract.

Name: over_contract_line_count
Description: Number of price-book-rated lines invoiced above the contract rate.

Name: over_contract_line_share
Description: Share of price-book-rated lines invoiced above the contract rate (0-1).

Name: disputed_line_amount_usd
Description: USD on invoice lines whose status is Disputed.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_INVOICE_LINE_CLASSIFIED.LINE_STATUS = 'Disputed' THEN V_INVOICE_LINE_CLASSIFIED.LINE_AMOUNT_USD ELSE 0 END)

Name: disputed_line_share
Description: Share of invoice lines whose status is Disputed (0-1).
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_INVOICE_LINE_CLASSIFIED.LINE_STATUS = 'Disputed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(V_INVOICE_LINE_CLASSIFIED.OI_LINE_ID), 0)

Name: invoice_count
Description: Number of OpenInvoice invoices.

Name: invoice_total_usd
Description: Sum of invoice totals in USD (equals SPEND_INVOICE amounts for stamped invoices).

Name: stamped_invoice_share
Description: Share of invoices carrying an ERP invoice id stamped back from spend analytics (0-1); invoices before 2025 are never stamped.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN OI_INVOICE.ERP_INVOICE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(OI_INVOICE.OI_INVOICE_ID), 0)

Name: surcharge_share
Description: Fees and surcharges as a share of invoice value (0-1).

Name: days_to_approve
Description: Average days from invoice date to approval date for approved invoices.

Name: afe_product_spend_usd
Description: Capital invoice line spend in USD by AFE well and generic product (from V_AFE_PRODUCT_COST).

Name: field_ticket_count
Description: Number of field tickets.

Name: classified_item_count
Description: Number of supplier items with an approved generic product mapping.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN SCM_ITEM_CLASSIFICATION.REVIEW_STATUS = 'Approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: items_needing_review
Description: Number of supplier items with an ML suggestion waiting for steward review.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN SCM_ITEM_CLASSIFICATION.REVIEW_STATUS = 'Needs review' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
